newsitem.title: GERMANY: WVZ details fourth German sugar beet test data.
newsitem.headline: WVZ details fourth German sugar beet test data.

text.p: Sugar industry association WVZ on Monday supplied the following details of the fourth German sugar beet test of the 1996/97 campaign.
It showed a higher sugar yield and a higher sugar content than 1995's fourth test.
Sugar yield per ha 9.71 t 7.81 t 8.79 t
Sugar weight per beet 114.1 grams 92.0 grams 114.3 grams
Avg beet weight 680 grams 602 grams 724 grams
Avg leaf weight 634 grams 648 grams 477 grams
Rain in past 2 weeks 20 mm 27 mm 37 mm
Beet weight per hectare 57.9 t 51.1 t 55.7 t
NOTE -- The fourth fortnightly 1996/97 test was taken on Sept 13 and results published on Sept 16. The fourth test last year was carried out on Sept 15, with results published three days later.
